items.title: Delivery Hero Cancels CEO Exit Plans Due to Uber’s $14.8 Billion Takeover Bid
items.summary: Delivery Hero  scrapped plans for co-founder  Niklas Östberg  to step down as chief executive, citing  Uber Technologies’  $14.8 billion takeover bid.  The German food-delivery company had said in May that  Östberg would step down in March of next year under plans for a leadership transition.  Earlier this month, Delivery Hero said it was in favor of a $14.8 billion takeover bid from Uber Technologies and advised shareholders to accept it.

items.title: Doordash Just Dropped 16% in a Month. Is It Time to Sell or Load Up?
items.summary: A 16% slide in a month puts DoorDash stock in awkward territory, and the culprit is something far newer and more unsettling than a weak consumer or a rate scare. The case for buying the dip and the case for cutting losses both hinge on a single question about where DoorDash's real value actually lives.
